tokens.name: ivory-100
tokens.usage: Raw palette. The page ground: the ivory of the jar label's crest.

tokens.name: ivory-200
tokens.usage: Raw palette. A deeper ivory for product bands and quiet panels.

tokens.name: ivory-300
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Image placeholders and pressed states on ivory.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Label navy. Headlines, buttons and the navy section ground.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Deeper navy for the footer and the most immersive moments.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Body text on ivory (6.4:1).

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Captions and secondary text on ivory (5.5:1) and ivory-200 (5.0:1).

tokens.name: mist-300
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Body text on navy (7.9:1).

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Label gold. Lines, dividers, the horizon thread and text 24px or larger only (3.1:1 on ivory).

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Gold for small text on ivory: eyebrows, Hindi names, links (5.5:1).

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Gold on navy: buttons, eyebrows, lines (6.9:1).

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Reference only. The dominant green of the logo artwork. Never used for UI: no buttons, text or backgrounds in green.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section background. Ivory by default; navy sections set data-theme="navy".

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: A second plane inside a section: product bands, the cart drawer, the footer.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, skeletons, pressed tiles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, product names, prices, primary button fill on ivory.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, sizes, helper text. Never below 13px.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: The gold thread: horizon line, dividers, focus rings, underlines. Lines only, or text 24px+.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small gold text: eyebrows, Hindi product names, link text.

tokens.name: button-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One primary button per screen.

tokens.name: button-ink
tokens.usage: Text on button-bg (13.8:1 ivory, 6.9:1 navy).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules between rows, card edges, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline, input border on hover.

tokens.name: crest
tokens.usage: The ivory tab the logo sits on when the header is navy. The logo always sits on ivory.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors only (6.0:1 on ivory).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations only, such as "Added to bag" (5.7:1 on ivory). Not a brand colour.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Salt, the way the lake makes it.
styles.usage: Hero headline, desktop. Use display-l on phones (≤ 640px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles; hero headline on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Product name on the product page; section titles on phones.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Product names on cards. The smallest Cormorant size: never set Cormorant below 28px.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.sample: from the lake, to your table
styles.usage: One quiet italic phrase per section at most: pull lines and sign-offs.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Black salt and lake salt, harvested and crafted on the shores of India's largest inland salt lake.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a headline. 60–65 characters per line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sulphurous and tangy, with the distinct aroma of kala namak.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: 1 kg jar · Best before 24 months from manufacture
styles.usage: Product meta, captions, footer copy. Never below 13px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline, in accent-text. Write the text in uppercase in the markup or with text-transform.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, always in Manrope (Cormorant's numerals sit unevenly). Use tabular figures in lists.

styles.name: hindi-l
styles.usage: Hindi product names beside display headings.

styles.name: hindi
styles.usage: Hindi product names on cards, in accent-text.

spacing.note: An 8px rhythm. Premium comes from space: sections breathe at space-10 to space-12.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title on cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Price to button; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter (minimum); paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; heading to body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; gap between a headline block and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The pause before a signature moment (hero to story).

radius.note: Quiet geometry: square images and panels, pill buttons. Avoid rounded cards.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Images, product bands, sections, cards.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, quantity steppers, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-crest
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of the logo crest tab on navy headers (matches the label crest).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the bag pill.

shadow.note: Almost none. Depth comes from the 3D jar and light, not drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Cart drawer and search panel only.

layout.note: Container and gutters. One idea per screen.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding under 640px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side padding from 1024px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header height on desktop (64px on phones).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

timing.note: Durations and easings, as plain values. Slow and settled; nothing bounces.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press states.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus, text reveals.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveals, image settles, page transitions.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Default easing: a quick start that settles slowly.

tokens.name: ease-inout
tokens.usage: Scroll-scrubbed and camera moves.
